text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I won't hesitate! From start to finish, 
I'll run my own race!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
UWOOOH, I will bring them down!! Even if 
my opponent is a god or Buddha!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"The final straight. In this single 
moment—give it everything!!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I will never give up!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: The Four
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!!!

Everyone gave 200% to run a race that only 
they could run. And thenâ

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!! I did it. I'm... at the pinnacle 
of my generation...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Everyone around the world! Thank you so 
much for watching us give our race 
everything we had!!

The winner was Narita Top Road. Breaking 
through proudly against the world's best, 
she showed off the sheer grandeur of her 
talent.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you so much! Our hard work 
really bore fruit, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Top Road-san, congratula...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ayabe-san, aren't you going to 
celebrate with us?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...If it were a little while ago... I 
could have said it. But..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Right now... it won't come out naturally. 
...Because they're the one rival I want to 
lose to least.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hearing you say that... makes me so happy!

More than just words of blessing, they 
were words of heartfelt recognition for 
her opponent.

And so, after the race, all four of them 
gathered in the underground paddock 
tunnel—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for all your hard work, 
everyone. The audience was thrilled, too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
There have been many great races up until 
now, —but I think today's was the hottest 
race of all.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
“Indeed. A stage truly shines only when 
it's graced by an exceptional cast.”

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Well, how it felt... wasn't bad, maybe. I 
was able to give it everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"It means I've gotten stronger... right? 
Even the weakest version of me, properly 
lifted up."

Each of them voiced their sense of 
fulfillment. And—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um...! I've been thinking. I don't want 
this excitement to just end with today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Won't you race with us next time too? In 
the year-end grand race, the 'Arima 
Kinen,' with this same lineup."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure the fans are looking forward to 
what comes next too. That's why!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see. A rematch for the title of 
strongest of our generation? That sounds 
fine by me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However... Top Road-san. Care to try a 
slightly different approach for the Arima 
Kinen?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I have a proposal. An idea that only makes 
sense now that you've raced this far.
choice_data_list: What kind of idea is that...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"We'll talk about that another time. 
Everyone must be tired today, after all."

And so, TM Opera O's proposal was 
postponed to a later date.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Did you see that, Spe-chan? That race 
just now."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
What do you say, after all this time...? 
Why not lend your ear—and your skills—as 
the Supreme Commander of Japan?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Grass-chan too, right? Not as a 
mentor lending a hand, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I wanted to try running together!
And that night—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm truly... I'm so, so very 
glad.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san, Opera O-chan, and Doto-chan—all 
three of them are in my class!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Getting to spend this time together with 
the four of us makes me so very happy!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I feel the same way.
Yeah, I feel the same way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those wonderful Umamusume. Being among 
them is what made Narita Top Road who she 
is today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, the Arima Kinen awaiting them in 
a month. What kind of finish line will the 
four of them reach?
